newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Power '96 net surges 50.34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Power '96 net surges 50.34 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.676 yuan vs 0.449 yuan
Net assets per share 3.97 yuan vs 3.49 yuan
Company name: Guangdong Electric Power Development Co Ltd.
NOTE: The results, calculated under Chinese accounting standards, were published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday.
Net profits were 563.75 million yuan in 1996 under international standards, the report said.
The company posted net profits of 376.97 million yuan in 1995 under international standards, according to the firm's 1995 annual report.

The firm's board of directors has proposed making a two-for-10 bonus share issue and a cash dividend of 0.2 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of a shareholders meeting scheduled for May 16, the 1996 report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Friday morning and resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
